info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Baggages-v2-spec
info.description: This API provides access to information regarding the baggage associated with airline flights. It allows users to retrieve details on baggage per flight, which is essential for both passengers and airline staff to manage and track luggage. Common consumers of this API include airline mobile applications, customer service portals, and baggage handling systems. By leveraging this API, airlines can enhance customer experience and operational efficiency in baggage management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about baggage associated with specific flights, including baggage allowances, tracking status, and additional services available for baggage handling.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information associated with flights. This body is structured in JSON format, and it must adhere to the defined schema. Please ensure that the necessary parameters are provided to obtain accurate baggage details.
